description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ampitiya Pallegama, Four Gravets and Gagawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320386
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the Commissioner's determination regarding title to specific land parcels (Parcel No. 88 and 117) in Kandy District.
